segments.sn45.180:1.3: Rūparāgo, arūparāgo, māno, uddhaccaṃ, avijjā – imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañcuddhambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni.
segments.sn45.180:1.5: Imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pañcannaṃ uddhambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo.
segments.sn45.180:1.7: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ … pe … sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
segments.sn45.180:1.8: Imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pañcannaṃ uddhambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya ayaṃ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo”ti.
segments.sn45.180:2.3: Rūparāgo, arūparāgo, māno, uddhaccaṃ, avijjā – imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañcuddhambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni.
segments.sn45.180:2.5: Imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pañcannaṃ uddhambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo.
segments.sn45.180:2.7: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti … pe … sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti rāgavinayapariyosānaṃ dosavinayapariyosānaṃ mohavinayapariyosānaṃ … amatogadhaṃ amataparāyanaṃ amatapariyosānaṃ … nibbānaninnaṃ nibbānapoṇaṃ nibbānapabbhāraṃ.
segments.sn45.180:2.10: Imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pañcannaṃ uddhambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya ayaṃ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo”ti.
segments.sn45.180:3.1: Ogho yogo upādānaṃ, ganthaṃ anusayena ca;
segments.sn45.180:5.1: Titthiyaṃ pañcamo vaggo, chaṭṭho sūriyena ca;
segments.sn45.180:5.3: Bahukate sattamo vaggo, uppādo aṭṭhamena ca.

lines: Thāmagatanti ca aññehi asādhāraṇo kāmarāgādīnaṃyeva āveṇiko sabhāvo daṭṭhabbo.
So sati paccayalābhe uppajjanārahatāya santāne anusetīti anusayo.
Uddhambhāgo mahaggatabhāgo, tassa hitānīti sabbaṃ heṭṭhā vuttanayattā na vuttanti adhippāyo.
